properties.description: The Clear selection button in the Repositories toolbar is not centered, and its current × icon does not clearly communicate clearing the selection. Use the shared icon-button presentation with a centered icon that conveys deselection; retain a clear tooltip and accessible name. Verify single and multiple selection, keyboard focus, and alignment beside the other toolbar controls. This changes presentation, not the meaning of selection.
properties.title: Improve the Repositories clear-selection button alignment and icon
